Group: Stakeholder reference and expert advisory groups
Responsibilities:

Composition:
Academics, thought leaders and health sector representatives. Not involved directly in decision-making but able to exert a high degree of influence due to their acknowledged expertise in the field and/or their role as formal or informal advisers to key decision-makers.
An expert advisory group is a small group of industry, sector or issue experts who are asked to provide technical input and advice.
This group should be established early in the project, because it can take time to identify individuals or representatives from key organizations who will participate.
